slides.title: Warm-up? Max. Metcon? Max.
slides.body: Every class is a race. By Thursday your best effort is Monday's warm-up pace.

slides.title: Tired legs can't sprint.
slides.body: Redline every day and your hard days get slower. You train hard, just never at your best.

slides.title: Two or three hard days a week.
slides.body: Pick them, then go all in. Every other class at 7 out of 10, clean reps, honest pace.

slides.title: Know the stimulus.
slides.body: Heavy and crisp, long and steady, or short and savage. Match the job, not the person next to you.

slides.title: Hard days get harder.
slides.body: Fresh legs hit splits you couldn't touch before. That's the fitness finally showing up.
